rationale: The assistant reached the correct conclusion that this is normal heat pump behaviour, correctly explained the cooler, longer drying and checked filters and programme without recommending parts. However it never asked the key unknowns the ground truth expected: whether clothes are actually dry at the end, the room temperature (an 8-10 C garage is a major factor), and it ignored the customer's own admission of opening the door to check, which it should have advised against. It also loosely labelled 'Cotton Cupboard Dry' an 'eco mode' and gave no fallback (contact Bosch under warranty if the drum never warms or loads come out damp), so the resolution is right but thinner than it should be.
